subject.title: fix(discord): oversized uploads can exhaust memory before failing

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new bounded Discord REST multipart default for low-level multipart callers while keeping `mediaMaxMb` as the documented send payload cap?
rationale: The code fix is now coherent, but the new fail-closed aggregate body cap is a compatibility boundary that maintainers should knowingly accept before merge.

options.title: Accept the bounded multipart default
options.body: Merge with the documented 100 MB default and configured `mediaMaxMb` plus overhead as the accepted Discord multipart boundary.

options.title: Require a broader cap policy
options.body: Ask for an explicit internal cap policy or override proof before merge if low-level Discord multipart callers must support bodies above the current default.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded multipart default
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented 100 MB default and configured `mediaMaxMb` plus overhead as the accepted Discord multipart boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame and recent merged PR metadata point to this handle as the best available owner for accepting the Discord REST compatibility boundary.
